title: Minuta 2025-03-27
summary: The minutes of the 27 March meeting document a unanimous 50bp cut to 9.00%, with forward guidance repeating that the Board could keep calibrating and consider a similar-magnitude (50bp) adjustment while insisting the stance stays restrictive, so the dovish, easing-biased message of the communique is confirmed. Versus the 6 February minutes (a 4-1 cut with Heath dissenting for 25bp), the Board has coalesced: the decision was unanimous with Heath aboard, and several members explicitly endorse continued equal-magnitude cuts, with one judging another 50bp move plausible at the next meeting. The discussion is dominated by a weakening economy - a Q4 contraction, rising recession probability, a negative and widening output gap and a cooling labor market - which the majority now says has made downside risks to inflation gain relevance, even as the official balance stays tilted up. Disinflation is seen as advancing (headline 3.67%, core 3.56% near its pre-pandemic average), though progress toward the 3% target has stalled since the start of the year and expectations remain above 3%. One member cautions that the room for further easing may narrow and that policy cannot be loosened as much as markets price, and the whole Board keeps stressing a restrictive stance, so on balance the minutes read broadly in line with the communique.

key_quotes.quote: la Junta de Gobierno con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad reducir en 50 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 9.00%.
key_quotes.context: Terceiro corte de 50bp, agora por unanimidade (Heath aderiu ao ritmo)

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno estima que hacia delante podría continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria y considerar ajustarla en magnitud similar.
key_quotes.context: Guidance mantendo viés de novos cortes de magnitude similar (50bp)

key_quotes.quote: Sin embargo, la mayoría indicó que los riesgos a la baja han cobrado relevancia. Agregó que esto último obedece a la pérdida de dinamismo de la actividad económica.
key_quotes.context: Maioria vê riscos de baixa para a inflação ganhando relevância pela fraqueza da atividade — nuance mais dovish revelada na minuta

key_quotes.quote: la tasa real ex ante se ubicó en un nivel de 5.6%, aún visiblemente por encima del intervalo de neutralidad de 1.8 a 3.6%.
key_quotes.context: Postura julgada claramente restritiva, com espaço para seguir cortando
